title: Darwin's dog that inherited a fear of butchers

tellings.quote: the case that Darwin was reported in a paper in nature was a dog that belonged to someone he knew that got very frightened whenever it went past a butcher's shop

plain: Charles Darwin is said to have reported, in a paper in the science journal Nature, a dog owned by someone he knew that became very frightened whenever it passed a butcher's shop, a fear it seemed to have inherited rather than learned. The biologist Rupert Sheldrake tells this on the show without naming the paper's date or author, as a case suggesting that fears and memories can be passed down. What he credits to Nature is only his summary of it, and nothing in his telling shows how the dog's fear was traced back to earlier generations.
